_doc: Hair under a hat, set in the Fit Studio and read by src/config/headwearFit.js. Written by scripts/fit-studio/hair-under-hat.mjs, not by hand. cover[hatId][hairId | '*']: polygons in HEAD fractions (x 0..1 across the skull, y 0 = skull top, 1 = chin) of hair the hat hides, even-odd; a pair's own entry wins over '*' (every hairstyle). layout[hairId][hatId | '*']: where that hairstyle sits while the hat is worn (w, top or cy, dx, same as a catalogue layout); '*' applies under every crown-covering hat, a hat's own entry wins and applies under any headwear.
